Bag of Herbs.summary: Buy the herb bag and its upgrade from the Herby Werby reward shop. Together they cost 400 points, and you can earn at most 100 a week, so this takes at least four weeks. Start it early.
steps: Travel to Herby Werby: climb down the tree roots in the north-east of Anachronia.
From the base camp, the quickest path crosses the Anachronia Agility Course (70 Agility; 50 Agility to enter the course).
Without the Agility levels, walk around: north, then east, then south under the bones, then north to the tree roots.
With 78 Magic, cast the Eastern Anachronia Teleport, then run north.
Earn the weekly maximum of 100 points inside the cave.
Take herbs from zygomites carrying healthy herbs (white particles) for points and Herblore XP.
Pick corrupt herbs (purple) and burn them on the ritual fire in the middle for more points.
Never burn healthy (green) herbs: it gives a 30-second penalty that cuts the points you earn.
There's no time limit, so you can leave and come back.
Spend your points with the ancient zygomite elder outside the cave.
Come back each week after the reset (Wednesday 00:00 game time) until you have 400 points.
Buy the herb bag, then the herb bag upgrade.
tips: Fastest points: burn corrupt herbs from the three big clusters on the south wall, which give 4 points each.
A Distraction & Diversion reset token (weekly) lets you play another 100 points in the same week.
Points (potent herbs) cap at 2,000, so spend them before you hit the cap.

Bean There, Done That.summary: Buy 13 upgrades from the Farmers' Market at Manor Farm, 38,600 beans in total. Beans come from selling animals you raise, so this takes steady play over many days.
steps: Do the player-owned farm tutorial at Manor Farm. It gives your first 500 beans.
Raise animals in your pens and sell them to the buyers for beans.
Buyers for small, medium and large animals appear on their own resets.
Put animals of the right size in your pens before a reset, so the buyer you want turns up.
Fully grown animals and buyers' preferred animals are worth more beans.
Buy the pen deeds first, so you can raise more animals at once.
Small pen deed I and II: 100 beans each
Medium pen deed I: 150 · Medium pen deed II: 500
Large pen deed I: 250 · Large pen deed II: 1,000
Buy the farm upgrades.
Bank chest: 300
6 farm totems: 1,200
Noted produce: 3,000
Seasonaliser wheel: 5,000
Buy the three trait boosts last; they cost the most.
Multiple trait boost (small): 6,000
Multiple trait boost (medium): 9,000
Multiple trait boost (large): 12,000
tips: The master farmer outfit and the Grandmaster Farmer rank each add 10% to beans from sales.
Granny Potterington gives bonus beans: 100 at level 99 Farming, 600 in total at 120, and 1,600 in total at 200 million XP.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Bean There, Done That

Bean There, Done That, Got the Postcard.summary: Buy 9 upgrades from the Farmers' Market at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm, 35,100 beans in total. Like the Manor Farm version, beans come from selling animals, so start early.
steps: Raise dinosaurs at the Anachronia Dinosaur Farm and sell them for beans.
Grow them fully and sell to buyers who want them, for the most beans.
Buy the pen deeds first, so you can raise more dinosaurs at once.
Small dinosaur pen deed: 100
Medium dinosaur pen deed: 500
Large dinosaur pen deed I: 1,000 · Large dinosaur pen deed II: 1,000
Dinosaur breeding pen deed: 1,000
Buy breeding for each pen size.
Breeding in small dinosaur pens: 6,000
Breeding in medium dinosaur pens: 8,000
Breeding in large dinosaur pens: 10,000
Buy the Anachronia storm barn deeds: 7,500.
tips: The master farmer outfit and the Grandmaster Farmer rank each add 10% to beans from sales.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Bean There, Done That, Got the Postcard

Big Chinchompa.summary: Score 1,111 points in a single game of Big Chinchompa, a Hunter activity that runs every hour. The achievement completes the moment you reach 1,111, so you don't have to finish the game.
need: A higher Hunter level helps a lot: better moths are worth more points
steps: Find the next game. Games start at half past every hour.
Use Nyriki's portal at his and Mieliki's house in the Tree Gnome Stronghold, just south of the Gnome Agility Course. It shows where the next game is and takes you there.
Climb down the hole Nyriki leaves in the ground to join.
Join at the start: a game lasts 20 minutes, or less if the chinchompa falls asleep early.
You can only join two games a day.
Take a protea flower from a corner of the lair and wield it. It draws in the best moth you can catch.
Catch soporith moths from the air or from shaking branches. Your jar holds 15.
Points per moth: black 21 (91 Hunter), grey 18 (78), purple 15 (65), blue 12 (52), green 8 (39).
1,111 points is about 53 black moths, 62 grey or 75 purple.
Empty the jar into the chinchompa's nest each time it's full. Points only count when you empty it.
Keep going until you pass 1,111 points.
tips: Boost your Hunter level with Hunter potions or the mud bath in Oo'glog to catch higher-tier moths.
Busy games end sooner, because everyone's moths fill the chinchompa's bar. A quieter game gives you more time.

From Ardougne with Love.summary: Spy on 40 penguins in Penguin Hide and Seek; your penguin spy device then upgrades itself. Only 12 penguins appear each week, so this takes at least four weeks. Start early.
need: Nothing to start. Some penguins hide in areas that need quests to reach.
steps: Get a penguin spy device from Larry at Ardougne Zoo (or from Chuck, after Hunt for Red Raktuber).
Each week, find the 12 disguised penguins and spy on them.
Use the spy device's hint for a penguin to see roughly where it is.
Penguins don't show on the minimap, but they're noisy, so turn up ambient sounds.
Come back after the weekly reset (Wednesday 00:00 UTC) and find the next 12.
After 40 penguins in total, the spy device upgrades on its own and the achievement completes.
tips: World 60 is the official Penguin Hide and Seek world. Its community chat, W60Pengs, shares where the penguins are. You have to be on World 60 to join it.
Teleports save the most time: lodestones, a jewellery box in your house, fairy rings and area teleports.
A Distraction & Diversion reset token (weekly) resets your weekly progress, so you can find another 12.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: From Ardougne with Love
RuneScape Wiki: Penguin Hide and Seek

Invention Gives Me the Blues.summary: Buy all 15 blueprints in the dwarven and cave goblin technology trees, 535 currency in total. The currency comes from Invention tasks, which appear once every 12 hours, so start early.
steps: Complete The Giant Dwarf and Death to the Dorgeshuun. They unlock the dwarven and cave goblin trees.
Take Invention tasks from a noticeboard: in the Invention Guild, near Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan, or near Drorkar in Keldagrim.
A new task appears every 12 hours. Up to 5 wait for you, so check in at least every 2½ days to waste none.
Finish tasks to earn Dwarven and Goblin Currency.
Buy the 8 dwarven blueprints from Drorkar in Keldagrim (295 Dwarven Currency).
Corporeal components: 10
Sprinkler MK1, Mining accumulator: 25 each
Book switcher, Calorie bomb: 35 each
Auto-sanctifier, Kinetic cyclone, Dungeoneering lock melter: 55 each
Buy the 7 cave goblin blueprints from Oldak in Dorgesh-Kaan (240 Goblin Currency).
Pestiferous components: 10
Mechanised chinchompa, Woodcutting accumulator: 25 each
B.A.N.K. Stander, Monkey mind-control helmet: 35 each
Electrified box trap, Oldak coil: 55 each
tips: Blueprints unlock at Invention levels 40, 50, 60 and 70, by tier.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Invention Gives Me the Blues
RuneScape Wiki: Cave goblin technology tree

Make Them Bleed.summary: Clear wave 20 of Rush of Blood, a Slayer combat activity in Prifddinas, then claim a Slayer XP lamp from Morvran. Any difficulty counts, including a practice run.
steps: Go to Morvran's dungeon under the Iorwerth Clan district in Prifddinas and talk to Morvran.
Start a Trial Run (practice) or a Reward Run. Either counts. Bronze is the easiest tier, at 85 Slayer.
Clear 20 waves, so you reach wave 21.
Dying is safe, but it ends the run at the last wave you cleared.
Talk to Morvran, inside or outside the arena, to claim the Slayer XP lamp. That completes the achievement.
tips: Bring two or three attack styles and hybrid armour. Some monsters need a particular style, and swapping full armour sets wastes time.
Bring stat-boosting potions, prayer restores, super antifire (dragons appear at every difficulty) and food. An aggression potion speeds up the waves.
The bank chest outside the arena doesn't pause the timer, so use it sparingly.

Power Planter II.summary: Unlock Plant Power (Tier 4) at Sydekix's Shop of Balance in the Garden of Kharid, 33,950 Crux Eqal favour in total. Favour comes from harvesting herbs, so start early.
steps: Talk to Polletix at the Garden of Kharid to start earning favour (50 Farming). He also tells you your daily herb.
Your daily herb is random for each player. You can also ask Polletix with the NPC Contact spell.
Grow herbs in any herb patch. Favour is added when you harvest the last herb from a patch.
Grow your daily herb whenever you can.
The daily herb gives 50 favour per seed, rising to 100, 200, 350 and 500 with Plant Power tiers 1 to 4.
Other herbs give less, from 10 to 35 favour per seed, depending on the herb.
Buy Plant Power tiers 1 to 4 from Sydekix, in order, as soon as you can afford each one.
Each tier boosts the favour from your daily herb, so earlier tiers speed up the later ones.
tips: Favour caps at 100,000.
sources: Ten Ton Hammer: Garden of Kharid guide

Top Town Hall.summary: Upgrade the Town Hall at the Anachronia base camp to tier 3. The buildings take about 538 hours to complete in total, so start as early as you can.
steps: Talk to Giles at the base camp. The tier 1 Town Hall is built during his short tutorial.
First build the Anachronia lodestone and turn the deposit box into a bank chest.
The wiki recommends these first, so you can get around the island and bank from the camp.
Assign your workers to gather resources: wood, vines, leaves, hides, stone and clay.
Either split them evenly, or put them all on one resource until you have enough, then switch.
Build the tier 1 Storehouse and Sleeping Quarters.
More Sleeping Quarters means more workers; a bigger Storehouse holds more resources.
Upgrade the Town Hall, Storehouse and Sleeping Quarters to tier 2.
Upgrade the Town Hall to tier 3. In total you need about 165,000 wood, 115,000 vines, 75,000 leaves, 100,000 hides and 115,000 stone.
tips: Compacted resources from skilling or killing creatures on Anachronia add 100, 200 or 400 resources, depending on your Town Hall tier.
The Command Centre in Fort Forinthry lets you manage the camp remotely.

Elven Titles.summary: Earn the title of each of the 8 elven clans in Prifddinas, one task per clan. Check your progress in the Customisations interface, under Titles > Miscellaneous; turn off filtering at the bottom left to see them all.
steps: Crwys: grow an elder tree in the Crwys district elder tree patch, then check its health.
Meilyr: harvest 50 harmony moss from the Harmony pillars.
Trahaearn: get 100 corrupted ores while mining Seren stones.
Iorwerth: complete 8 dark beast Slayer assignments from Morvran.
Cadarn: defeat 1,000 Cadarn rangers or magi in total.
Amlodd: summon a light creature familiar, use its Enlightenment scroll, then talk to Lord Amlodd.
Ithell: craft 100 crystal flasks.
Hefin: complete 200 laps of the Hefin Agility Course.
tips: Start the Crwys elder tree and the Meilyr harmony moss first. They're Farming tasks that take real time to grow, so work on the others while you wait.

Family Spirit Tree.summary: Have four spirit trees fully grown at the same time, in Brimhaven, Port Sarim, Etceteria and Manor Farm, then claim a Farming XP lamp from Glouron in Prifddinas.
steps: Plant spirit trees in the patches at Brimhaven and Port Sarim.
When both are fully grown, check their health, then tell Glouron in the Crwys district of Prifddinas.
This also completes the Power of Three Spirits achievement.
Plant the third and fourth trees, at Etceteria and Manor Farm.
When all four are fully grown and health-checked, talk to Glouron to claim the Farming XP lamp. That completes the achievement.
tips: A temporary Farming boost counts when planting a spirit tree. Checking health and growth potions don't need the boost.
A spirit tree can't be moved without replanting it, so keep all four where they are.

A Fort Of My Own.summary: Upgrade all nine buildings in Fort Forinthry, in the Wilderness north of the Jolly Boar Inn, to tier 3.
steps: Work through the Fort Forinthry quests. New Foundations must be nearly complete before you can build beyond the tier 1 Workshop.
Start each building at the Fort Forinthry blueprints table in the Workshop.
Each blueprint has a Construction level requirement. A boost works, and is only needed when you start the blueprint.
You must build each tier before the next one.
Gather the construction materials (timber and stone) the blueprint asks for, then build at the hotspots.
Take all nine buildings to tier 3: Workshop, Town Hall, Chapel, Command Centre, Kitchen, Guardhouse, Grove, Ranger's Workroom and Botanist's Workbench.
tips: Building gives Construction XP along the way, so this doubles as training.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: A Fort Of My Own

A Reptile's Dysfunction.summary: Upgrade Zorgoth's ring, a reward from Requiem for a Dragon, into Zorgoth's soul ring by doing Necromancy rituals at the Ungael ritual site while wearing it.
steps: Speak to the Archivist at the Ungael ritual site first.
Equip Zorgoth's ring and perform rituals at the Ungael ritual site.
Any ritual counts, and its level doesn't matter.
Each ritual has a chance to upgrade the ring, and it's guaranteed by the 100th.
When the ring upgrades, the achievement completes.
tips: Use the lesser necroplasm ritual: at 39.6 seconds it's the quickest.
Speed glyphs make rituals faster. Three Speed III glyphs with the alteration necklace reach the 50% cap (102 Necromancy to draw, or boost).

Absolute Planker.summary: Buy the plank box and both of its upgrades with contract credits from Construction Contracts: 500 credits, which is about 100 contracts.
steps: Get a Construction contract from an estate agent.
Rimmington has an estate agent and a sawmill close together; a house in Rimmington makes House Teleport the quickest way there.
Prifddinas's Ithell district has an estate agent and a sawmill side by side.
Go to the contract's location, ask the NPC what the repair needs, then build at the empty furniture hotspots.
Hand in contracts for contract credits (up to 5 each).
Buy the plank box (50 credits), its first upgrade (150) and its second upgrade (300) from the Estate Agents' Shop.
tips: Contracts also give the Baby Yaga's House pet, and strange and golden rocks, so this pairs well with Construction training.

Abyssal Shortcut.summary: Unlock the asylum gate in the Senntisten Asylum and open the shortcut to its lower level.
steps: Kill abyssal lords until one drops a gate key.
Use the key on the asylum gate, near the abyssal savages on the upper level of the asylum.
Attach a rope to the broken railing to open the shortcut to the lower level. That completes the achievement.

Almost as Perky as a Prawn.summary: Unlock all 15 Prawn Perks from the Prawnbroker in your house's Aquarium. Each perk costs one prawn perk point.
need: 63 Construction (for the Aquarium's bathysphere and diving suit)
steps: Build an Aquarium in your player-owned house: place a bathysphere and a diving suit.
Earn prawn perk points.
Each golden fish egg gives one point. Eggs come from fishing (0.5% chance), from prawn balls and prawn crackers, or from trading crystal motherlode shards with Wythien.
You also get a point for reaching 1, 20, 100 and 200 prawn balls.
Spend points on perks at the Prawnbroker, one per perk. Each tier must be finished before the next opens.
Once all 15 are unlocked, talk to the Prawnbroker and choose 'Prawn perks' to complete the achievement.
tips: Prawn balls come from the life points the fish you catch would heal, so fish whatever heals the most per hour.
At 99 Fishing, the Prawnbroker gives 50 bonus prawn balls.
Save a golden mystery egg for the egg you least want to fish for.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Almost as Perky as a Prawn

Ancient Eastern Tortle Portals.summary: Activate all three tortle portals on The Islands That Once Were Turtles, in the Arc, using 100 ancestral energy in total.
steps: Get 100 ancestral energy.
Harvest it from ancestral energy springs near a dead moai on the Uncharted Isles (95 Divination, boostable).
Or harvest positive and negative energy (90 Divination) and combine them into ancestral energy (95 Divination).
The Tuai Leit's Own miniquest gives 50.
Activate each of the three tortle portals on The Islands That Once Were Turtles with the energy.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Ancient Eastern Tortle Portals

Annihilator.summary: Earn the title 'the Annihilator' by defeating all four nihil at once in the Pit in Freneskae, during or after Fate of the Gods.
steps: Go to the Pit in Freneskae. After the quest, stand in the middle of the room and choose 'Yes - replay the boss fight!'.
Get all four nihil into combat with you before you kill any of them. If you aren't fighting all four, it won't count.
Defeat all four to complete the achievement.

Balanced Combat Triangle.summary: Solve a lockbox puzzle. Lockboxes appear in some anagram steps of master clue scrolls.
steps: Work through master clue scrolls until an anagram step gives you a lockbox.
Solve the puzzle: make every tile show the same symbol (Attack, Ranged or Magic).
Clicking a tile changes it and the four tiles directly next to it.
Return the lockbox to the NPC to carry on with the clue.
tips: A lockbox skipping ticket skips the puzzle, but then the achievement doesn't count.

Bane Tuner.summary: Learn the Tune Bane spell during or after Ritual of the Mahjarrat.
steps: In Kethsi, find the Tune bane scroll and read it to learn the spell.

Bill & Ben's Egg/Salon Joint Venture.summary: Complete six small achievements around the Anachronia dinosaur farm after the Extinction quest.
steps: A Hatching Pair: ask Prehistoric Potterington about zygomites.
Off to See the Lizard: help Galgalar at the incubator (incubate a good egg or compost a bad one), then show Galgalar a sharp shell shard.
Egg McGuffin: talk to Ben, by the mystical tree south of the farm, about Carestyling and show him some tempered fungal shafts.
Mycomanagement: talk to Bill, by the mystical tree on Anachronia's west coast, and show him some dinosaur 'propellant'.
Fibbin' Archery Sequence: talk to Salusan about fletching Elder God arrows, then show her one.
Needles from Skips: once you've made an Elder God arrow and finished the last two, show Prehistoric Potterington an Elder God arrow.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Bill & Ben's Egg/Salon Joint Venture

Bipedal Mask.summary: Make a Tuska mask from five pieces that airut drop, but only while you're on an airut Slayer task.
steps: Get an airut Slayer assignment.
Kill airut on task until you have all five pieces: the Tuska mask top, plate, headpiece, upper tusks and lower tusks.
Combine the pieces into the Tuska mask. You don't need to be on task for this part.

Bridge over Fremmy Waters.summary: Finish all five unabridged Fremennik Sagas, story dungeons in Daemonheim told by Skaldrun.
steps: Talk to Skaldrun, west of Thok in Daemonheim, and pick an unlocked saga.
You can't take any items into a saga, not even the ring of kinship.
Complete Three's Company.
Complete Vengeance.
Complete Thok It To 'Em.
Complete Nadir.
Complete Thok Your Block Off.
tips: Unlocking a door that needs a key saves a checkpoint. If you leave, you can restart from it.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Bridge over Fremmy Waters

Da Vinci Who?.summary: Study three Ancient Invention blueprints: Ancient Gizmos, Ancient Tools and the XP Capacitor.
need: 106 Invention for the XP Capacitor (89 with an extreme invention boost)
steps: Study an 'Ancient gizmos' blueprint (85 Invention, or 68 with an extreme invention).
Study an 'Ancient tools' blueprint (93 Invention, or 76 with an extreme invention).
Study an 'XP Capacitor' blueprint (106 Invention, or 89 with an extreme invention).
tips: Each blueprint has a tradeable and an untradeable version; either works.

Deadlier Catch.summary: After the Deadliest Catch quest, hunt the sea monster Thalassus ten more times.
steps: Talk to Jones outside the bank in the Fishing Guild to start a hunt.
Hunt the Thalassus ten times.
The ten hunts give 46,660 Hunter XP in total.

Dinosaur Hunter.summary: Catch each of the nine dinosaurs in Big Game Hunter on Anachronia at least once. One of each is enough; you don't have to play a full hour.
steps: Start with the three that take fish as bait (75 Hunter, 55 Slayer).
Arcane apoterrasaur: raw shark
Scimitops: raw sailfish
Bagrada rex: raw manta ray
Use their meat as bait for the next three.
Spicati apoterrasaur (80 Hunter, 60 Slayer): raw bagrada rex meat
Asciatops (85, 65): raw arcane apoterrasaur meat
Corbicula rex (90, 70): raw scimitops meat
Then use those dinosaurs' meat for the last three.
Oculi apoterrasaur (94, 74): raw asciatops meat
Malletops (95, 75): raw corbicula rex meat
Pavosaurus rex (96, 76): raw spicati apoterrasaur meat
tips: Each kill gives big Hunter and Slayer XP, so the later dinosaurs double as training.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Anachronia Big Game Hunter

Draconic Decoctions.summary: Read five dragonkin potion recipes. Each recipe comes in four numbered fragments found while excavating at the Orthen Dig Site, or you can buy the finished recipe.
need: 90 Archaeology for the first recipe; 120 for all five, if you excavate them yourself
steps: Excavate the hotspots for each recipe's four fragments. They drop in order, 1 to 4.
Archaeology potion: varanusaur remains (90) or dragonkin reliquary (96)
Summoning renewal: dragonkin coffin (99) or autopsy table (101)
Holy aggroverload: experiment workbench (102) or Aughra remains (106)
Powerburst of opportunity: Moksha device (108) or Xolo mine (113)
Spirit attraction: Xolo remains (119) or Saurthen debris (120)
Read each completed recipe: Archaeology potion, Summoning renewal, Holy aggroverload, Powerburst of opportunity and Spirit attraction.
tips: Completed recipes trade on the Grand Exchange, about 9 million coins for all five, so buying one skips its excavation.
Each recipe can be found at two hotspots, so pick whichever suits your level.

Everything Is Still Treemendous.summary: Cut 100 eternal magic logs from eternal magic trees. It also adds 10 to every log type in your wood box.
steps: Cut eternal magic trees until you've received 100 eternal magic logs.
tips: Logs used up by Superheat Form, the inferno adze or Always Adze don't count. You have to actually receive the logs.
Extra logs from eternal magic wood spirits do count.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Everything Is Still Treemendous

Famous.summary: Complete Morvran's special Slayer challenge: kill 12 bosses once each, solo, to earn the title 'the Famous'.
steps: Get the challenge from Morvran in Prifddinas.
He offers it now and then; refusing has no penalty.
You can also pay 100 Slayer points to have him assign it, once a week.
Kill each boss once.
Araxxi · Giant Mole (hard mode) · Kalphite Queen · King Black Dragon · Queen Black Dragon
Dagannoth Prime · Dagannoth Rex · Dagannoth Supreme
Commander Zilyana · Kree'arra · K'ril Tsutsaroth · General Graardor
After the last boss, the crystals go to Morvran automatically and you get the title.
tips: Each kill gives you a dark crystal that weakens you for the bosses left, so save the hardest for early.
Kills only count solo: if another player is nearby it won't count. Turn off lootshare and leave any group.
Kills with deathtouched darts don't count.
Finishing gives 50,000 Slayer XP, plus 45 Slayer points if you've done Smoking Kills.

Gaps, Traps and Laps.summary: Complete one lap of each of the 16 Agility courses below.
steps: Run one lap of each course:
Burthorpe · Gnome Stronghold · Brimhaven Agility Arena · Werewolf Skullball
Jaleustrophos Pyramid · Penguin · Barbarian Outpost · Ape Atoll
Wilderness · Bandos' Throne Room · Werewolf · Het's Oasis
Hefin Agility Course · Dorgesh-Kaan · Gnome Stronghold (advanced) · Barbarian Outpost (advanced)
Werewolf Agility Course: the lap only counts if you finish the deathslide without falling.
Brimhaven Agility Arena: tag the active pillar to get an Agility Arena ticket.
Dorgesh-Kaan: use both the agility route and the grapple route to help Turgall get 2 parts from the boiler.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Gaps, Traps and Laps

Gross Misconduct.summary: Kill 144 demons in the Wilderness. It's also needed to finish the Civil War I miniquest.
steps: Kill 144 demons anywhere in the Wilderness.
Easiest: hellhounds, lesser demons and greater demons in the Forinthry Dungeon or the Wilderness Crater. They have few life points and lots of spawns.
Also counting: abyssal demons, beasts, lords and savages, black demons, greater demon ash lords and berserkers, Kal'gerion demons, revenant demons, ripper demons, waterfiends and gargoyles.
The Chaos Elemental doesn't count.
tips: Track your count in the achievement's description: Hero › Achievements › Lore › Combat.

Heal, Quickly.summary: Buy the Scroll of renewal from the Dungeoneering reward shop for 38,000 Dungeoneering tokens, then read it.
steps: Earn 38,000 Dungeoneering tokens by doing dungeons in Daemonheim.
Buy the Scroll of renewal from the Dungeoneering reward shop and read it.

Here to Slay.summary: Equip a corrupted slayer helmet after consuming an ensouled spectral lens.
steps: Create a corrupted slayer helmet. The first one costs 2,500 Slayer points.
Consume an ensouled spectral lens.
Equip the corrupted slayer helmet.
If you consumed the lens before making the helmet, take the helmet off and put it back on.

I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests).summary: Complete all 51 miniquests listed below. Each one opens its own guide, and finished ones are ticked from your account.
steps: Open each miniquest in the list above and follow its guide.
RuneMetrics tracks miniquests, so they tick off by themselves when you refresh.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: I've Got a Little List (of Miniquests)

In Rituals We Trust.summary: Perform each of 13 Necromancy rituals at least once, at the Um or Ungael ritual site.
steps: Go to a ritual site: Um (from the Necromancy! quest) or Ungael (from Requiem for a Dragon).
Perform each ritual once:
Lesser, greater and powerful communion
Lesser, greater and powerful necroplasm
Lesser, greater and powerful essence
Lesser ensoul material, ensoul material and greater ensoul material
Manifest ectoplasm
sources: RuneScape Wiki: In Rituals We Trust

It Should Have Been Called Aetherium.summary: Smith a full set of elder rune armour up to +5. It also unlocks masterwork melee equipment.
steps: Get a full set of elder rune armour +4 (helm, platebody, platelegs, gauntlets, boots) plus 192 elder rune bars, or 384 bars to make it from scratch.
Upgrade each piece to +5.
Full helm: 64 bars · Platebody: 160 · Platelegs: 96 · Gauntlets: 32 · Armoured boots: 32
tips: Buying the +4 pieces and bars cost about 7.5 million coins when checked; buying only the bars, about 5.5 million.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: It Should Have Been Called Aetherium

It Should Have Been Called Ancestral.summary: Craft a full set of Starbloom equipment up to +5. It also unlocks masterwork magic robes.
steps: Get 384 starbloom cloth (768 starbloom thread) to make the set from scratch.
Make each piece and upgrade it from +4 to +5.
Hat: 64 cloth · Robe top: 160 · Robe bottom: 96 · Gloves: 32 · Boots: 32
sources: RuneScape Wiki: It Should Have Been Called Ancestral

It Should Have Been Called Chinskin.summary: Craft a full set of apex hide armour up to +5. It also unlocks masterwork ranged equipment.
steps: Gather the materials: 384 apex leather, 12 apex sinew, 3 steel studs and 1 steel bar.
Make each piece and upgrade it from +4 to +5.
Cowl: 64 leather, 2 sinew
Body: 160 leather, 5 sinew, 1 steel studs, 1 steel bar
Chaps: 96 leather, 3 sinew, 1 steel studs
Vambraces: 32 leather, 1 sinew, 1 steel studs
Boots: 32 leather, 1 sinew
tips: When checked, the materials cost about 12.7 million coins and the set sold back for about 2 million less.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: It Should Have Been Called Chinskin

It Still Should Have Been Called Aetheri.summary: Smith a full set of primal armour up to +5. It also unlocks masterwork 2h swords.
steps: Get the primal armour +4 pieces plus 192 primal bars, or 384 bars to make it from scratch.
Upgrade each piece to +5.
Full helm: 64 bars · Platebody: 160 · Platelegs: 96 · Gauntlets: 32 · Armoured boots: 32
tips: Buying a +4 set cost about 17 million coins when checked; buying only the bars, about 9 million.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: It Still Should Have Been Called Aetherium

Kiln Fighter.summary: Finish the Fight Kiln once: 37 waves of TokHaar, a harder sequel to the TzHaar Fight Cave.
need: A fire cape (from the TzHaar Fight Cave), paid once to enter
steps: Enter the Fight Kiln. The first time, you hand over a fire cape.
Fight through all 37 waves.
The waves are the same every time, and monsters always spawn in the same places, so you can plan ahead.
Lure TokHaar into safespots. Lava slowly fills the cave and covers them, so later on use the low wall in the middle.
Use the lava crystals that appear every other wave: they give bonuses like brief invincibility or a full prayer and life point restore. Save them for the 7 TokHaar-Jads and Har-Aken.
tips: A cutscene plays after waves 10, 20, 30 and 34.

Long Live the Queen.summary: Get the first dragonkin journal, which drops from your first Queen Black Dragon kill.
steps: Go to the Grotworm Lair. Remora's necklace (from Song from the Depths) is quickest; otherwise use the Port Sarim lodestone and run north-west.
Defeat the Queen Black Dragon. The kill counts when you activate the final crystal in the arena.
Take the first dragonkin journal from the drop.
tips: Equip any Slayer boosts, like dragon slayer gloves, before you activate the final crystal.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Long Live the Queen

Lunar Master.summary: Unlock all 11 Livid Farm spells by earning 130,000 produce points helping Pauline Polaris on the northern part of Lunar Isle.
steps: Switch to the Lunar spellbook. You need it for every task on the farm.
Talk to Pauline Polaris at Livid Farm and do her tasks to earn produce points.
Tasks reset every 60 seconds. With practice you can do all of them in a round.
Unlock the spells in order as your total points pass each mark:
South Falador Teleport: 10,000
Repair Rune Pouch: 20,000
North Ardougne Teleport: 35,000
Remote Farm: 45,000
Spiritual Healing: 60,000
Make Leather: 75,000
Disruption Shield: 90,000
Vengeance Group: 100,000
Trollheim Farm Teleport: 110,000
Tele-group Trollheim Farm: 120,000
Borrowed Power: 130,000
tips: Check your produce points in your currency pouch.
The spell thresholds count every point you've ever earned, not your current balance.

My Last Resort.summary: Unlock every upgrade at War's Wares, War's shop at War's Retreat. They're paid for with boss kills, which aren't used up, so you need 2,000 boss kills in total.
steps: Kill bosses to build up your boss kill count.
Unlock each upgrade at War's Wares as you reach its kill count:
Hub teleport: 10 boss kills
Second attunable portal: 100 boss kills
Altar of War: 200 boss kills
Ability cooldown: 500 boss kills
War's Grimoire: 750 boss kills
Adrenaline crystal: 1,000 boss kills
Adrenaline potion cooldown: 2,000 boss kills
tips: Buying an upgrade with boss kills doesn't lower your kill count, even though the dialogue says it costs kills.

Myreque in Memoriam.summary: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz once you've finished the In Memory of the Myreque miniquest and the River of Blood quest.
steps: Talk to Veliaf Hurtz.

Mystical Moonstone.summary: Learn to make moonstone jewellery from the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um.
steps: Wear a brown apron, with no cosmetic override on your torso.
Put a cut or uncut moonstone in your backpack.
Talk to the Former Master Crafter in the City of Um.
tips: You don't need to have done Housing of Parliament.

Out into the Ourania.summary: Unlock the Ourania Teleport spell from Baba Yaga after Lunar Diplomacy.
steps: Switch to the Lunar spellbook.
Talk to Baba Yaga, inside the walking house with chicken legs on the northern part of Lunar Isle.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Out into the Ourania

Pious Prayers.summary: Unlock Chivalry, Piety, Rigour and Augury by beating the Knight Waves training ground in Camelot after King's Ransom.
steps: Climb the western ladder of Camelot castle to the top floor.
Talk to the squire outside the door to start.
Defeat the eight Knights of the Round Table.
Any combat style works, but Summoning, Prayer, binds and stuns don't.
Each knight drains some of your combat stats as you fight.
tips: Once you've won you can't go back in, and it also counts for the Nomad's Requiem quest.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Knight Waves training ground

Port Life.summary: Do the Player-owned port tutorial once you have level 90 in any of its skills.
need: Level 90 in one of: Agility, Construction, Cooking, Divination, Dungeoneering, Fishing, Herblore, Hunter, Prayer, Runecrafting, Slayer or Thieving
steps: Enter your port through a portal: south-west of the Rusty Anchor pub in Port Sarim, north-east of the Prifddinas lodestone, or in the south of the Menaphos Port district. The ports table in Fort Forinthry works too.
Follow the tutorial to the end.

Potion For a Lady.summary: Make a super melee potion yourself, find an unreadable page in Daemonheim, and give the potion to Lady Meilyr for a melee XP lamp.
steps: Find an unreadable page while doing dungeons in Daemonheim.
Make a super melee potion yourself.
With the potion in your backpack, talk to Lady Meilyr in Prifddinas.
Choose 'What can I do here?', then 'Ask about the combination potion recipes...'.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Potion For a Lady

Potion Mixer Master I.summary: Unlock 27 combination potion recipes from the Recipe Shop in Prifddinas, 12.5 million coins in total. Some need an unreadable page from Daemonheim first.
steps: Find unreadable pages while doing dungeons in Daemonheim, for the recipes that need one.
Buy each recipe from the Recipe Shop (through Lady Meilyr in the Meilyr Clan district):
Grand strength potion: 100,000 coins
Grand ranging potion: 100,000 coins
Grand magic potion: 100,000 coins
Grand attack potion: 100,000 coins
Grand defence potion: 100,000 coins
Super melee potion: 150,000 coins
Super warmaster's potion: 200,000 coins
Replenishment potion: 200,000 coins
Wyrmfire potion: 200,000 coins
Extreme brawler's potion: 300,000 coins
Extreme battlemage's potion: 300,000 coins
Extreme sharpshooter's potion: 300,000 coins
Extreme warmaster's potion: 400,000 coins
Supreme strength potion: 500,000 coins
Supreme attack potion: 500,000 coins
Supreme defence potion: 500,000 coins
Supreme magic potion: 500,000 coins
Supreme ranging potion: 500,000 coins
Brightfire potion: 600,000 coins
Super prayer renewal potion: 750,000 coins
Holy overload potion: 700,000 coins
Searing overload potion: 700,000 coins
Overload salve: 800,000 coins
Supreme overload potion: 900,000 coins
Supreme overload salve: 1,000,000 coins
Perfect plus potion: 1,000,000 coins
Aggroverload: 1,000,000 coins
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Potion Mixer Master I

Potion Mixer Master II.summary: Unlock three advanced combination potion recipes from the Recipe Shop in Prifddinas, 3.7 million coins in total. No unreadable pages needed.
steps: Talk to Lady Meilyr or a harmony pillar farmer in the Meilyr Clan district of Prifddinas to open the Recipe Shop.
Buy the recipes:
Spiritual prayer potion: 1,000,000 coins
Elder overload potion: 1,200,000 coins
Elder overload salve: 1,500,000 coins
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Potion Mixer Master II

Qualification - Guildmaster.summary: Complete the Archaeology achievements that make you a guildmaster of the Archaeology Guild.
steps: Complete each achievement in the list above. Each one opens its own guide.
Talk to Acting Guildmaster Reiniger to claim five material manuals, hi-spec monocles, tarpaulin sheets and cups of archaeologist's tea.
tips: You don't have to talk to Reiniger to become guildmaster; the achievement completes on its own.
Guildmaster gives a research team of 5, research professors, another relic loadout and new Guild Shop rewards.

Rhian in Gold - The Original.summary: Collect all 32 golden rocks, two for each of 16 skills, and build the Statue of Rhiannon once in the Shattered Heart activity in Prifddinas.
need: 75 in each golden rock skill and in Constitution (boosts don't work)
steps: Talk to Auron Ithell by the golden plinth in the Tower of Voices to start receiving golden rocks.
He tells you which skill levels you're still missing.
Train the skills to find golden rocks; they're random per action.
They're more likely in a Prifddinas district while the Voice of Seren is active there.
Train with lots of quick actions to get more chances.
Add the rocks to the plinth in pairs, until the Statue of Rhiannon is built.
tips: A metamorphic geode always gives a strange or golden rock you don't have yet.
Examine a golden rock to see which skill it's for.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Rhian in Gold - The Original

Slayer Master.summary: Clear 20 waves of Rush of Blood on its hardest tier, Platinum, to earn the title 'Slayer Master'.
steps: Talk to Morvran in Prifddinas and start Rush of Blood on Platinum. A reward run or a trial run both count.
Clear 20 full waves. Only reaching wave 20 isn't enough.
tips: Any earlier titles you're missing (the Abyssal, the Dark and the Beast) unlock at the same time.
The Make Them Bleed guide covers what to bring to Rush of Blood.

Slide To The Left.summary: Solve a puzzle box from Treasure Trails: slide the pieces back into the right picture.
steps: Do clue scrolls until a step gives you a puzzle box.
Solve the sliding puzzle.
tips: The wiki has a step-by-step method for puzzle boxes; it's listed in the sources.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Slide To The Left

Stay Safe.summary: Loot the treasure chest at the end of the Stronghold of Player Safety, a dungeon north of Barbarian Village and south of Edgeville.
steps: Enter the Stronghold of Player Safety, under the Misthalin Training Centre of Excellence.
Pull the old lever on the upper floor.
Enter the secure area and loot the treasure chest.
sources: RuneScape Wiki: Stronghold of Player Safety
